content_units: 90-Minute Road Trip Mix
A clean, upbeat 18-song sequence from your pool that starts easy, lifts through the middle, and lands on a feel-good finish.
Context note: exact runtimes vary slightly by version, but this set should land close to   90 minutes  .
Ordered Playlist
Artist   Song   Energy Role   Why it fits here
1   George Ezra   Budapest   Mellow start   Warm, relaxed opener with easy road-trip charm
2   Vance Joy   Riptide   Mellow start   Keeps the acoustic-indie tone light and catchy
3   Capital Cities   Safe and Sound   Gentle lift   Smooth groove without jumping too fast
4   Empire of the Sun   Walking on a Dream   Gentle lift   Dreamy, scenic-driving feel
5   Coldplay   Viva La Vida   Early build   Adds momentum with a big singalong hook
6   Rusted Root   Send Me On My Way   Early build   Sunny, loose, open-road energy
7   American Authors   Best Day of My Life   Build   Bright, stomping rhythm raises the mood
8   OneRepublic   Good Life   Build   Big chorus, optimistic and road-ready
9   Portugal. The Man   Feel It Still   Midpoint pop boost   Tight, funky burst right in the middle
10   Harry Styles   Watermelon Sugar   Midpoint pop boost   Breezy pop keeps the energy playful
11   BENEE, Jawsh 685   Sunroof   Mid-high   Windows-down summer vibe
12   The Weeknd   Blinding Lights   High energy   Strong pulse and instant momentum
13   WALK THE MOON   Shut Up and Dance   High energy   Peak singalong section starts here
14   Dua Lipa   Levitating   Peak pop   Keeps the dancey momentum soaring
15   Florence + The Machine   Dog Days Are Over   Peak release   Big emotional lift and cathartic energy
16   Imagine Dragons   On Top of the World   Feel-good turn   Starts the happy landing stretch
17   The Lumineers   Ho Hey   Warm comedown   Familiar, communal, easy-to-sing closer setup
18   The Killers   Mr. Brightside   Final payoff   Huge recognizable finish with lasting buzz
Why This Order Works
-   First 4 songs:   mellow, breezy, and scenic without feeling sleepy.
-   Songs 5-10:   steady climb into bigger hooks and more bounce.
-   Songs 11-15:   the energetic center, leaning pop/indie with strong singalong value.
-   Songs 16-18:   uplifting finish that feels celebratory rather than abrupt.
Alternate Swaps From Your Pool
If you want to tune the vibe slightly, these are the best substitutes:
-   Electric Love   in for   Sunroof   if you want a more indie-pop shimmer
-   Valerie   in for   Ho Hey   if you want a funkier late-playlist lift
-   Take It Easy   in for   Budapest   if you want a more classic soft-rock start
-   Counting Stars   in for   Good Life   if you want a punchier midsection
